name: Xefi data center (Technoparc de Civrieux)
notes: Regional press (Le Progrès, 2019): Xefi inaugurated a second data center (first installed 2014 at Technoparc de Civrieux, Ain, and Tier 3 certified - reported as a national first). Enterprise/IT-services hosting facilities; no hyperscale or large carrier-neutral campus identified in Ain.

name: NavLink data center (Sophia Antipolis, Antibes)
notes: Carrier-neutral colocation in Sophia-Antipolis science park, 51 Rue Henri Laugier, Antibes (near Nice airport). Aggregator-grade existence evidence; verify operator page for capacity/status.

name: Hexatom Sophia Antipolis data center
notes: Colocation facility at 950 Route des Colles, 06410 Biot/Nice area (Sophia Antipolis). Aggregator-grade listing; capacity not disclosed.

name: Euclyde DC3 - Sophia-Antipolis data center
notes: Regional colocation/data-center operator facility in Sophia Antipolis; aggregator listing.

name: Azur Datacenter Sophia Antipolis
notes: Facility at 950 Route des Colles, 06410 Biot; ~500 m2 data floor, ~200 racks per aggregator. Aggregator-grade existence; capacity/status to verify with operator.

name: Titan Datacenter Mougins
notes: New hosting/data-center specialist recruiting 44 staff before opening in Mougins (Alpes-Maritimes); regional economic media. Status: opening imminent; capacity not disclosed.

name: nLighten Edge data center Valbonne
notes: Official operator page: secured edge data center / colocation at Valbonne (Sophia Antipolis park), ~700 m2. Existence/location A-; capacity not published.

name: Hosteur Sophia-Antipolis data center
notes: Hosteur.com operates a data center in Sophia-Antipolis with fully redundant multi-operator connectivity; operator page. Small/medium commercial hosting facility.

name: PanaFrance data center campus (ex-aérodrome de Romilly-sur-Seine)
notes: Major campus project on the former Romilly-sur-Seine aerodrome (Aube, Grand Est): revised (May 2026) to occupy the full 40 ha across tranches 3-4, ~€1bn investment, ~1,000 jobs (500-600 direct), evolved toward an HPC/centre de calcul de haute performance with commissioning of the new infrastructure mentioned for autumn 2026. Grade B (DCMag + L'Union/regional press); verify permits (PC/ICPE) for A-grade confirmation.

name: OVHcloud SBG1-SBG5 Strasbourg campus
notes: OVHcloud Strasbourg campus (Rhine-side industrial estate): SBG1, SBG3, SBG4, SBG5 operating; SBG2 destroyed in March 2021 fire (SBG4 restored, SBG3 rebuilt). SBG5 (9 Rue du Bassin de l'Industrie) inaugurated Sep 2022, ~€30M rebuild, ~20 MW Tier III per aggregators (capacity B/C). Official OVHcloud newsroom = A for existence/opening.

name: OVHcloud new Strasbourg datacenter project (2025-2026)
notes: Nov 2025 (infonet.fr): OVHcloud launching a major Strasbourg project with €160-180M investment for a sustainable data center. Announced/intent stage per trade press; verify permit filings for confirmation.

name: UltraEdge Strasbourg hub
notes: UltraEdge (edge datacenter operator) lists Strasbourg as one of its France hubs (per FR methodology seed list). Operator-page existence; capacity not published.

name: RackNerd Strasbourg datacenter
notes: Budget hosting provider colocation in Strasbourg; operator marketing page. Small facility; low-grade evidence.

name: Digital Realty / Interxion MRS campus Marseille (MRS1-MRS5)
notes: Marseille port-area campus (Enceinte Portuaire): MRS1-MRS3 operational (MRS3 opened as Interxion's third; MRS1/MRS2 ex-SFR Netcentre), MRS4 under construction (~13.6 MW expected, N+1 UPS/gen, 2N cooling), MRS5 construction finishing along the A55 grand port maritime as of Aug 2026 (La Marseillaise). Environmental-authorization record on projets-environnement.gouv.fr for MRS4 + substation (A-grade file). Capacity figure is MRS4 only; campus total higher.

name: Digital Realty MRS6 (Bouc-Bel-Air)
notes: MRS6 in Bouc-Bel-Air (~20 km from Marseille): ~€700M conversion of a 26,000 m2 warehouse into a seven-hall AI-ready facility, ~50 MW, 225 kV RTE connection; construction reported starting 2026, delivery ~2028 (aggregator + France3 on 24,000-server project with local controversy). Capacity is campus-plan/planned MW (grade B/C).

name: OpCore MRS1 (Marseille)
notes: Carrier-neutral colocation, 71 Av André Roussin / 70 Chem. du Passet, Marseille; distributed TriCore redundancy, 30+ international operators, HDS certification (operator page A- for existence). ~10 MW per aggregators (C); DCD confirms OpCore operates one Marseille site (B).

name: Telehouse data center Les Pennes-Mirabeau
notes: Project announced autumn 2025 in the Sibylles zone, Les Pennes-Mirabeau (commune bordering Marseille): eight buildings on ~6 ha (60,000 m2). Permis de construire was signed by the previous mayor; new mayor opposes ('the project will not go ahead as-is') and a legal recourse has been filed. Status: permitted but contested/appealed.

name: Edged Energy data center Saint-Louis (Marseille 15e)
notes: ~€300M data center on the former Saint-Louis Sucre industrial brownfield (Marseille 15th arr.): 21,900 m2 over 3 levels, ~20 MW IT power, 12 backup gensets totalling 98 MW, heat-reuse with municipality; PC filed 8 Aug 2025 (with cinema-studio project), demolition of old buildings done, environmental-authorization consultation publique opened 24 Aug 2026, delivery targeted end-2028, works to start before end-2026 (La Marseillaise, 08/08/2026). Grade B; A-grade once prefectural authorization granted.

name: Saint-André logistics + data center project (Marseille)
notes: Feb 2025 (BFMTV Marseille): project combining a 37,500 m2 logistics warehouse with a four-level data center in Saint-André (Marseille 16e), extending an existing A55 transport site; local controversy. Announced stage; developer not named publicly.

name: Oracle Cloud France South (Marseille) region - eu-marseille-1
notes: Official cloud region existence (grade A for region, not physical address): OCI eu-marseille-1 France South (Marseille), paired/DR-style region; physical facilities not publicly located. Confirms Marseille as cloud-region presence in Bouches-du-Rhône.
